final_answer_accuracy.formula: count(answer_correct IS True) / 155 after human grades for manual_required; failed forced incorrect; auto-only rate remains auto_graded_accuracy

strict_answer_accuracy.formula: answer_correct IS True over all 155 tasks; failed forced False; human grades applied for manual_required

strict_overall_task_success.formula: status == 'full' AND answer_correct IS True AND tool_selection_correct IS True AND all_tool_invocations_successful IS True; denominator = 155; failed/partial forced incorrect; does NOT require evidence_correct or terminal_contract_valid; human overall_task_success does NOT override this conjunction

common_strict_answer_success.formula: status == 'full' AND answer_correct IS True; failed/partial forced incorrect; denominator = 155; cross-baseline comparable answer+completion metric

cross_condition_comparability.flat_note: Flat audit reported identical strict-answer and strict-overall rates (85/155), i.e. an answer-centric closure — not the MCP-Zero tool_selection∧execution conjunction.
cross_condition_comparability.mcp_zero_strict_overall_formula: status == 'full' AND answer_correct IS True AND tool_selection_correct IS True AND all_tool_invocations_successful IS True; denominator = 155; failed/partial forced incorrect; does NOT require evidence_correct or terminal_contract_valid; human overall_task_success does NOT override this conjunction
cross_condition_comparability.strict_overall_reason: MCP-Zero strict_overall_task_success additionally requires tool_selection_correct and all_tool_invocations_successful; Flat's published 85/155 matches an answer-level rate, so the two must not share a comparison column.
cross_condition_comparability.common_strict_answer_success_formula: status == 'full' AND answer_correct IS True; failed/partial forced incorrect; denominator = 155; cross-baseline comparable answer+completion metric
